notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: Presence of Gond attached to Pili-Pala.
description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Elf Warriors.
